shared_platform_plugin.purpose: shared WordPress infrastructure, navigation, platform sync, health, registry and common services

security_boundary: OMOS_BRIDGE_API_KEY server configuration is preferred over database storage
public REST responses never expose the bridge key
WordPress does not own Council authority, Human Gate, Decision Records or PostgreSQL
WordPress does not authorize deployments, payments, credential changes or consequential external actions
authenticated Ask OMOS submits to the governed runtime and does not create a competing local Decision Record store

verification.repository_gate: PHP syntax + manifest contract + shortcode registry contract
verification.live_gate: WPVibe verifies installed version, /wp-json/omos/v1/sync, shortcode health and runtime connectivity per target site
verification.production_rule: Repository implementation alone does not certify a live WordPress installation or the OMOS runtime.
